messages:
maya (VP People): Quick follow-up to the all-hands 1 re: headcount & org changes. Dropping the plan and open for short Qs here.

sam (CTO): High level: 28 net new hires this FY. Q2 emphasis: serving/runtime + infra. Q3: product + devex. Q4: reserves + customer escalations.

maya (VP People): Hiring cadence: Q2 burst ~20 prioritized reqs, then steady hires. We are carving explicit spots for Dedicated & Private expertise (security/compliance).

lisa (People Ops): Recruit briefs, compensation bands, and interview rubrics will land in #recruiting by COB tomorrow. We will also publish relocation/transfer policy notes for internal candidates.

taylor (eng-lead): Any guidance on contractor vs FTE mix? need to plan budget & onboarding.

maya (VP People): Plan is FTE-first for core runtime and infra roles. We will use contractors for short-term UX/ops spikes. Budgeted mix is roughly 80% FTE / 20% contractors for this slate.

dev (IC): Will internal mobility be prioritized? curious about interviews for current Redwood employees.

lisa (People Ops): Internal candidates encouraged. We will run a fast-track internal review for transfers with hiring managers; still expect interview loops but shorter timelines.

taylor (eng-lead): For the runtime hires, what level of deep stack expertise do you expect (TF/Torch/CUDA vs system design)?

sam (CTO): Systems-first. Hands-on ML infra experience preferred. CUDA/quantization experience is a differentiator but not mandatory. Look for shipping inference features and debugging at scale.

maya (VP People): On reporting changes: these are consolidation moves to reduce duplicated teams, not headcount cuts. We1ll share a before/after map and manager scripts for 1:1s by Thursday.

dev (IC): Any change to promotion cadence or leveling because of reorg?

lisa (People Ops): Promotion cycles unchanged. We will update role families to reflect cross-team expectations and run an optional calibration session next week.

taylor (eng-lead): Will new hires be rostered into oncall immediately?

sam (CTO): New hires will shadow oncall initially. We are not changing rotations immediately; if pager metrics don't improve we will hire for SRE capacity.

maya (VP People): Next steps: Lisa posts the reqs + rubrics; Sam and I hosting a 30m manager Q&A Friday 10:00. We1ll also publish a read-only pipeline tracker for visibility (no PII).

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring & org Q&A (managers)" Fri 10:00 1 maya, sam, lisa.

maya (VP People): Thanks all 1 if you have sensitive concerns about reporting lines or team moves, DM Lisa or me directly.
